scope: Actual Vue page and normal user clicks, calm motion, isolated native response scenarios; not native filesystem or installed evidence
checks: Mixed move keeps three explicit outcomes; retries only notExecuted, preserves completed results and review ID, and keeps both successful requests in undo
Undo retry excludes completed and needsReview paths; final unresolved result stays visible without a repeat button
Batch rename preserves completed/review rows across safe retry and rule refresh; only the explicitly not-executed file is submitted again
A lost move reply after a simulated commit is unknown, not notExecuted: result stays visible and no automatic/direct retry is offered
A move error without an explicit disposition is conservatively needsReview; matching error text or source existence is not treated as retry permission
A lost batch-rename reply leaves all attempted rows for review, disables preview replay and offers no retry
A lost undo reply removes attempted items from the direct-undo queue and keeps all three review outcomes visible
A folder-picker failure is only a form error, not an unknown file mutation; typing a destination can still complete normally
